title: The Last Draught
description: Monarque restores himself. +25 HP, +5 Soul, and every cooldown shortens by 1.
flavor: He pours it out the way one pours for the dead.

monarqueLines.early: I restore what I choose to restore. Continue.
monarqueLines.fraying: Even a fraying king mends himself. Watch.

artDirection: A tarnished-gold chalice tilting over black stone; the liquid is smoke-dark, not red.

title: The Reckoning
description: Monarque breaks his own seal. He loses 15 HP, every other vessel loses 17 HP, and the round ends at once.
flavor: A king who will not be beaten will end the room instead.

monarqueLines.early: The rite ends. Everything ends when I decide.
monarqueLines.fraying: Ruin it all. I will still stand in the ashes.

artDirection: A cracked ring of ash around a single standing figure; fissures run outward through the floor.

title: The Inverted Realm
description: The lower stat wins for 2 rounds. Weakness is crowned, and strength is a debt.
flavor: Down is a direction only if someone is still standing on it.

monarqueLines.early: Now the order turns over. Climb, if you can.
monarqueLines.fraying: Down is up. Up is whatever I decree.

artDirection: A black cathedral shown upside down, chandeliers rising like roots, the vessel's shadow upright.

title: The Blinding Eclipse
description: Opponents must play blind this round. They choose a card without knowing which is which.
flavor: The light is not removed. You are merely taken out of it.

monarqueLines.early: Choose without sight. Prove you deserve the light.
monarqueLines.fraying: Darkness suits a throne. Fight blind, vessel.

artDirection: A black disc swallowing a tarnished-gold halo; cards below it drawn as faint outlines only.

title: The Oracle’s Gaze
description: Monarque reads the vessel: its Soul reserve and its strongest cards. The report is private and expires next round.
flavor: He does not guess. He remembers how this ends.

monarqueLines.early: I see your whole hand. Try to surprise me.
monarqueLines.fraying: I see all of it. Enough to crush you.

artDirection: A single vellum eye bound with iron thread, the pupil a slow candle flame.

title: Monarque’s Boon
description: For 4 Soul, Monarque grants himself one boon: Immortality (no HP damage for 2 rounds), Absolute Power (the card's chosen stat is doubled) or The Unmaking (every opponent loses a card).
flavor: A god's wish costs less than a mortal's, and takes more.

monarqueLines.early: Three wishes lie before me. I need only one.
monarqueLines.fraying: A wish. Mine to grant, and mine to take.

artDirection: Three sealed doors of bone and bronze, one ajar, no light behind it.

title: The Binding Seal
description: A card the vessel played is sealed and removed from play for 10 rounds, with Soul paid by tier.
flavor: What he binds, he remembers how to bind.

monarqueLines.early: Be still. A fallen thing is only a card.
monarqueLines.fraying: Sealed, as I sealed gods. Hold, little vessel.

artDirection: A wax seal pressed into vellum over a card's silhouette, thin cracks already forming.

title: The Unraveling
description: The Unraveling is laid upon a vessel. It drains HP each round and worsens when the holder fails to be rid of it. It may be passed on or broken.
flavor: It is not a punishment. It is what the vessel was always going to become.

monarqueLines.early: It is the mark of the vessel. Carry it with pride.
monarqueLines.fraying: It spreads as I willed. What you are, I can unmake.

artDirection: A thread of grey light unspooling from a hairline crack in a face-shaped silhouette.
